title: ArtifactOutput
description: One bounded NDJSON record per artifact, carrying signal and never payload.

path.description: Artifact path inside the workspace jail.

format.description: Precise container or codec detected from the magic bytes.

bytes.description: Artifact size in bytes as reported by the filesystem.

title.description: Document title from the artifact metadata.

author.description: Document author from the artifact metadata.

producer.description: Producing application from the artifact metadata.

megapixels.description: `width * height / 1e6` (image) — the size figure a human reasons about.

text_chars.description: Total extracted text length in characters, independent of the excerpt.

text_excerpt.description: Bounded head of the document text.

truncated_parts.description:
Container members that reached the `max_part` safety ceiling.

The ceiling is the anti zip-bomb bound and it does not move; a member
that reached it may have been read as a prefix, so the parsed signal
comes with this warning instead of passing as complete.

ok.description: Outcome of the run, stamped by the writer

code.description: Machine error code, present when ok is false

exit.description: Process exit status, present when ok is false

target_resolved.description: Absolute target the run resolved, or `-` for standard input; several subjects are joined with `,` in invocation order

target_source.description: Where the target came from: named in the invocation line, inherited from the workspace slot, or the standard-input stream

workspace_source.description: Where the workspace root came from: the `--workspace` flag or the process working directory

records_suppressed.description: Records the writer dropped before the terminal event: `--filter` rejections, `--select` projections that emptied the record, dedupe duplicates and `--limit` cuts. It counts records, never files, so it does not compare with `files_matched`: one file can contribute several records

files_budget_dropped.description: Entries the `--limit` budget dropped, in the unit the verb produces: files for walking verbs, records for streaming ones; a floor, because workers may stop before producing the rest

files_planned.description: Files the run would have modified in `--dry-run` or `--preview`; absent from a run that really wrote

truncated.description: The record itself was cut by `--truncate-content` or `--max-output-bytes`, so the fields are shorter than the source

truncated_records.description: Records the writer cut this run, counted once per record

SheetSignal.description: Bounded signal for one spreadsheet sheet.

name.description: Sheet name as declared by the workbook, or the part index when absent.

columns.description: Number of columns in the first populated row.

header.description: Column labels taken from the first populated row, blank when unlabeled.

types.description: Inferred scalar type per column over the sampled rows.

sample.description: Sample rows, each holding one value per column.

SlideSignal.description: Bounded signal for one presentation slide.

index.description: One-based slide position in presentation order.

title.description: First text run of the slide, which carries the slide heading.

text_chars.description: Total characters of text on the slide.
